name: baoyu-motion
description: Writes short animated films, explainers, product demos, data stories and title sequences, as code, scene by scene, and plays them in a player that runs on your computer, where you comment on a moment and export MP4 or GIF. Includes a director skill for films with something to say, and a chart skill for the charts in them. Runs locally on Node.js 22 or later; export needs Chrome.
